name: Mem0 Memory
description: Declarative Mem0 external memory provider for CoTree. The local SQLite store stays authoritative for structured round-trip + evidence chain + provenance; Mem0 (https://mem0.ai) adds a cross-session semantic search layer. Auth via MEM0_API_KEY only - no source fork, no embedded keys.

mem0.description: Mem0 semantic memory layer over the local authoritative store.
